No dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl|bash`, `wget`, or `base64` decoding) are present. The file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and does not introduce any supply-chain risks. While the source is unpinned (as typical for `-git` packages), this is not inherently unsafe, especially when the Git history is available for audit.
